_doc: OID X per-ticker sentiment feed (SHADOW) config, x-sentiment-v0.4 (2026-10-26). Runs on the mini only. Nothing in the live score, orders or alerts reads its output. Hot-reloaded each pass.
fetch_enabled_note: ON 2026-10-26 (Jeffrey approved 'Hot 10', ~$4.85/day worst case). SHADOW: nothing in the live score, orders or alerts reads it. Kill: touch ~/oid-data/state/x/SENTIMENT_STOP or set false.

credentials.note: Same existing desk X key x-on-surge uses. Path only; never printed or logged.

budget.note: 2026-10-26 Jeffrey: desk X day cap $5 -> $10; month $100 -> $220 so it never binds (x-on-surge ~$4.45 + name-credit $0.30 + this feed ~$4.85 = ~$9.60/day x up to 22 trading days). This job is capped at $5.25/day, $110/month; desk_x_* = combined across x-on-surge + name-credit + this.

universe.core_note: empty = the 61 symbols in the latest ~/oid-data/score/scores-YYYYMMDD.jsonl
universe.note: Hot 10 = position-trigger symbols first, then top movers by |chg_pct| (ETFs excluded), max 10

sample.note: X minimum is 10 posts/request; since_id so a post is only paid once

filters.note: plus x-on-surge blocklist + follow-farm/low-activity checks for authors already in the x-on-surge user cache (no paid user lookups)

schedule.pull: launchd com.oid.desk.x-sentiment every 300 s; no-op outside 06:30-13:00 PT weekdays; active preset hot-10: hot tier (10 names) chatter every 15 min, tone sample hourly
schedule.scorecard: launchd com.oid.desk.x-sentiment-scorecard weekdays 13:45 PT (after the 13:40 labels job)

cadence.note: Minutes from the 06:30 PT open; launchd wakes every 5 min and each tier runs once per N-minute block (first wake inside it). *_sample_every_min=N: tone sample on the first pass of each N-minute block (0 = every pass). 0 for *_every_min turns that tier off. Each name: $0.005 chatter count + up to $0.05 for a 10-post sample + $0.005 baseline once/day.

presets_note.spec (not affordable): full 15 / hot 5, sample every pass: ~$116/day worst case
presets_note.chatter-61: full_every_min 30, full_sample false, hot_every_min 0: ~$4.30/day (61 names, chatter only)

scorer.note: engine jev = TypeSafe Jev Choice {bullish, bearish, neutral, not_about_ticker} per post; s = P(bull)-P(bear); not_about_ticker (P>=offtopic_min_p or argmax) dropped. Any Jev error/cap -> lexicon for that post. engine lexicon = word list only. Ledger state/x/jev_budget.json. Measured ~660 input tokens/post = ~$0.00003/post (~$0.01 per 350 posts).
